commits.message:
fix(rule)!: a title wider than the rule is cut with an ellipsis between rule cells, as Rich's is (rich-rule-thri)

Rule now lays its line out as Rich's __rich_console__ does: the title is cut
to the width less Rich's required_space (4 centred, 2 aligned) with an
ellipsis, a rule cell stays either side, and a rule with no room past that
is bare. A left- or right-aligned title no longer carries a space on its
closed side.

The ellipsis cut Panel already ported from Rich's Text.truncate is now
cutLabel in embed.ts, shared by both; the space either side of a label is
Panel's _title padding and moves to Panel.

effects-feel: fade and dissolve carry a strip's fills with its words (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i) (#316)

* feat(examples): effects-feel fade and dissolve carry a strip's fills with its words, from and to the terminal's ground (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

* feat(examples): effects-feel breath spreads from a wandering heart, shimmer rides an uneven current, pulse slower and deeper (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Pulse peaked at 0.06 dE_OK and read as nothing. The 1 fps step gate, not
the contrast shares, was what held it: a deeper move has to be a slower
one. Pulse is now 30 s at swing 0.55, peaking at 0.24 on the strip and
0.10 on text, inside the gate.

A light that tints at constant lightness was tried to get past the shares
and dropped: on the dark ground it changed nothing, and on Latte a tint
alone breaks a fill's contrast floor.

* effects-feel: pulse spreads at one pace whatever the width; neighbour check runs through a whole breath (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)
